newsitem.title: USA: NYNEX takes long-distance orders in Arizona.
newsitem.headline: NYNEX takes long-distance orders in Arizona.

text.p: NYNEX Long Distance Co, a subsidiary of NYNEX, said Monday it began taking orders for long-distance telephone service from customers in Arizona.
NYNEX did not immediately say when it expected the service to be fully operational in Arizona.
The company also has received approval to operate long-distance service in eight other states: Colorado, Idaho, Iowa, Michigan, Montana, Texas, Utah and Wyoming.
It expects to begin offering service in Florida as early as next month.
